meta.name: pm-skill-creator
meta.description: Design a new PM skill through guided conversation. Use when you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a compliant skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过对话引导将想法转化为合规技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有原始内容或想法，想把它塑造成一个合规的技能。
copy.tagline_en: Shape raw content or ideas into a compliant skill through guided conversation.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a compliant skill.

howto.what: 这个技能会通过对话引导你一步步设计一个新的 PM 技能。它会问你最多 5 个问题，然后根据你的回答生成一份完整的 SKILL.md 草稿。
howto.when: 当你有一个想法或原始内容，想把它整理成一个符合仓库规范的技能时，就可以使用这个技能。

say.text: 帮我设计一个技能，把定价框架变成可用的技能。
say.note: 技能会引导你完成设计流程。

say.text: 我有一些工作坊笔记，想做成一个交互式技能。
say.note: 技能会帮你确定技能类型并生成草稿。

howto.what_en: This skill guides you through designing a new PM skill via conversation. It asks up to 5 adaptive questions and generates a complete SKILL.md draft based on your answers.
howto.when_en: Use this skill when you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a compliant skill.

say_en.text: Help me design a skill from my pricing framework.
say_en.note: The skill will walk you through the design process.

say_en.text: I have workshop notes and want to turn them into an interactive skill.
say_en.note: The skill will determine the type and generate a draft.
